hyperedges.rationale: checkAccess pattern: first try owner read, then share lookup with GSI3 fallback, returning sentinel errors (ErrNotFound, ErrForbidden) used across meeting, research, knowledge, and upload services.

hyperedges.label: Tiered Bedrock Claude model usage (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku)
hyperedges.rationale: Cost-optimization architecture: Opus for complex summarization, Sonnet for transcript refinement, Haiku for fast metadata extraction (action items, tags, sentiment).

hyperedges.label: Step Functions crawler pipeline (orchestrator -> tech/news -> ingest)

Real-time streaming transcription path: WebSocket API Gateway → Transcribe Streaming with Identity Pool credentials

hyperedges.name: deep_research_agent_pipeline

hyperedges.name: insights_ecosystem

hyperedges.name: stt_quality_optimization
